description: Search the votings (głosowania) of a term by a phrase in the title, by sitting and by date range. Returns the same fields as get-votings; get the breakdown by club with get-voting.

dateFrom.description: Earliest voting date, in YYYY-MM-DD format

dateTo.description: Latest voting date, in YYYY-MM-DD format

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; defaults to 50

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

proceeding.description: Number of the plenary sitting (posiedzenie Sejmu): the `number` field from get-proceedings

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

title.description: Phrase to search for in the title of the voting, in Polish (e.g. podatek dochodowy)

name: search-votings

date.description: Date and time of the voting

kind.description: ELECTRONIC, TRADITIONAL or ON_LIST (voting on a list of options)

majorityType.description: Majority required, e.g. SIMPLE_MAJORITY or ABSOLUTE_MAJORITY

votingNumber.description: Voting number within the sitting, used by get-voting

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: Search votings
